text: Android: several accounts in the UI: start screen, Accounts screen, grouped overview, invite routing (B2)

From the B1 review (T-291), to settle in B2: (1) lists are keyed by the server's list id, so two accounts on the SAME server that share a list would collide on the primary key and mergeList keeps the first account's row. Recommendation: allow one account per server (the add-account form refuses a second one on a server this phone already has, with a message), which keeps the schema; re-keying lists by (accountId, id) is the alternative if the maintainer wants several logins per server. (2) LoginViewModel.login still calls authRepository.removeOtherAccounts(keep) to mirror the old wipe; B2's add-account path must not, and the start screen's sign-in for a phone with no account may. (3) Collaborator notifications carry the account id but not yet the label; show the label only when more than one account exists. (4) The CurrentAccount shim reads the first server account in sortOrder; remove it as the ticket says. (5) On a fresh install the typed server URL is now saved only on a successful login; a failed first attempt plus a restart falls back to the default suggestion. Fine for B2's start screen, but keep it in mind.

From the B1 review: also (6) PendingInvite.accountId is stored but never read: invites from any host are redeemed at the current account's server, so the host matching in design section 5 is real work, not a tweak; (7) removing the CurrentAccount shim also touches DefaultCurrencyState (singleton), the ApiSource binding used by 8 view models, and SyncTriggerModule.provideSyncer's fullListsAccountId; (8) a canonical server URL (T-298 item 12) is what one-account-per-server compares on.

Decisions and screen plan agreed with the maintainer on 2026-09-24 (supersede the earlier one-account-per-server note; several logins per server ARE allowed, see the B1b re-key ticket this now depends on):
* Account label = email + full server URL (path included), so prod and stage on one host stay distinct. Invite links match on the URL prefix, never the host alone; several matches ask "Join with which account?", none opens the login form prefilled with that URL and redeems after sign-in.
* Accounts screen lives in the MAIN MENU. One row per account: email, server URL, state (signed in / signed out: tap to sign in / app too old for this server / on this phone), that account's own sync figures; reorder sets the overview order. Actions: Add account (login form, prefilled with the last typed address, keeps existing accounts) and Remove (today's warning plus the unpushed count and the hint to copy lists to the local area first). NO user-facing "Sign out": the signed-out state is entered only when the server rejects the token (password change, admin reset, 62-day idle) and left by signing in again from the row's banner. Data is kept meanwhile (T-257/T-260).
* Start screen (no account): mark, Sign in, Register, later "Use without an account" (B3).
* Overview: one account = today's screen. Several = a section per account with a small header, local area last, a small marker on each card; pending invites under their account; New list gets an account picker defaulting to the account of the last opened list.
* Signed-out account: its lists stay visible and editable, a banner in its section offers sign-in; no notification. The app routes to the login screen only when no account can sync.
* App too old: per account, a banner in its section and its sync paused; the full-screen block only when every server account is affected.
* List screen unchanged apart from the account label as app-bar subtitle with more than one account. Settings: default currency moves under the account row; theme, language, show-checked, notifications stay app-wide. Registry (all items) gets the same account sections as the overview.
